---
title: "Extended tables"
subtitle: "The complete set of supporting tables produced by the analysis pipeline, each opening to its full contents"
---

```{python}
#| label: cargar-corpus
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "study"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis

idx = rh.corpus_index(); caps = rh.corpus_captions(); titles = rh.corpus_titles()
kpis([
    (str(len(idx["article_tables"]) + len(idx["tables"])), "Tables in this chapter"),
    (str(len(idx["article_tables"])), "Principal tables"),
    (str(len(idx["tables"])), "Supporting tables"),
])
```

These are the numeric tables behind the extended plates, each with its title and its methodological
note, unfolding to its full contents. They are data you can read and reuse: unlike the plates, which
needed the microdata to draw, every table here ships with the repository.

The [result tables](tables.qmd) chapter holds the tables the main figures are built from; this chapter
holds the wider set the pipeline produced. The case definition is the one of the main analysis, F84
without Rett syndrome, and every count is administrative recognition, not prevalence or incidence.

## Principal tables

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-articulo
#| output: asis
for it in idx["article_tables"]:
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Supplementary tables

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-suplementarias
#| output: asis
group = None
for it in idx["tables"]:
    if it["group"] != group:
        group = it["group"]; print(f"\n### {group}\n")
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    meta = dict(meta); meta["title"] = f"{it['id']}. " + meta["title"] if not meta["title"].startswith(it["id"]) else meta["title"]
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```
